what: Where the bundled Lisp lives, relative to the runtime root (this checkout or an installed share/romacs, beside gnu-lisp/). Each root and its immediate subdirectories, minus excluded ones, follow GNU's load-path (crates/romacs-vm-gui/src/startup.rs runtime_load_path). tools/lib/bundled_autoloads.py scans the same directories (each root's own files are Romacs's runtime Lisp, preloaded or loaded on demand; its subdirectories are packages) with GNU's loaddefs-generate into the autoloads file, which --loadup loads before the user's init.
